<!DOCTYPE html>



    
    Signage
    
    


    

    
No active flyers.

    
    
        window.SIGNAGE_BOOT = ;
    

    
    (function () {
        "use strict";
        var boot = window.SIGNAGE_BOOT || {};
        var SECRET = boot.secret || "";
        var POLL_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000;

        var body = document.body;
        var stage = document.getElementById("stage");
        var msg = document.getElementById("signage-msg");
        var slides = [];
        var timer = null;
        var current = [];

        function imgUrl(id, v) {
            // No literal ampersand anywhere in this file (invalid in XML
            // text). String.fromCharCode(38) is the query separator.
            var amp = String.fromCharCode(38);
            return "/signage/image/" + id
                 + "?secret=" + encodeURIComponent(SECRET)
                 + amp + "v=" + encodeURIComponent(v || "");
        }

        function applyConfig(cfg) {
            var isPortrait = cfg ? (cfg.orientation === "portrait") : false;
            var isFade = cfg ? (cfg.transition_style === "fade") : false;
            body.className = isPortrait ? "portrait" : "";
            stage.className = isFade ? "fade" : "cut";
        }

        function sameList(a, b) {
            if (a.length !== b.length) { return false; }
            return a.every(function (x, i) {
                if (x.id !== b[i].id) { return false; }
                if (x.seconds !== b[i].seconds) { return false; }
                return x.v === b[i].v;
            });
        }

        function activate(i) {
            slides.forEach(function (el, j) {
                el.classList.toggle("is-active", j === i);
            });
            if (timer) { clearTimeout(timer); timer = null; }
            if (!slides.length) { return; }
            var secs = parseInt(slides[i].getAttribute("data-seconds"), 10) || 8;
            timer = setTimeout(function () {
                activate((i + 1) % slides.length);
            }, secs * 1000);
        }

        function buildSlides(list) {
            if (timer) { clearTimeout(timer); timer = null; }
            stage.innerHTML = "";
            slides = list.map(function (f) {
                var el = document.createElement("div");
                el.className = "signage-slide";
                el.style.backgroundImage = "url('" + imgUrl(f.id, f.v) + "')";
                el.setAttribute("data-seconds", String(f.seconds || 8));
                stage.appendChild(el);
                return el;
            });
            if (msg) { msg.style.display = slides.length ? "none" : "flex"; }
            if (slides.length) { activate(0); }
        }

        function poll() {
            fetch("/signage/playlist?secret=" + encodeURIComponent(SECRET),
                  { cache: "no-store" })
                .then(function (r) { return r.ok ? r.json() : null; })
                .then(function (data) {
                    if (!data) { return; }
                    applyConfig(data);
                    var next = data.flyers || [];
                    if (!sameList(current, next)) {
                        current = next;
                        buildSlides(current);
                    }
                })
                .catch(function () { /* keep showing the current playlist */ });
        }

        applyConfig(boot);
        current = boot.flyers || [];
        buildSlides(current);
        setInterval(poll, POLL_MS);
    })();
